title: Ceiling on the Catch-Up Credit by Payment Record
content:
**Patient Payment Plans — schedule of the ceiling on the catch-up credit**

The cap on the catch-up credit depends on the plan's payment record: for a plan with 9 or more scheduled installments paid less than 12 whole months before today it is one full regular installment; for a plan with 6 to 8 scheduled installments paid in that span it is one half of the regular installment; for any other plan it is one quarter of the regular installment.

| Scheduled installments paid in the last 12 whole months | Ceiling on the catch-up credit |
|---|---|
| 9 or more | One full regular installment (100 percent) |
| 6, 7 or 8 | One half of the regular installment (50 percent) |
| 5 or fewer | One quarter of the regular installment (25 percent) |

**Counting the record.** The figure is the number of payments on the plan ledger posted as scheduled installments and dated less than 12 whole months before today. Down payments, arrears payments, extra-principal payments and payoffs are not scheduled installments and are not counted.

**Regular installment.** The regular monthly installment standing on the plan. The ceiling is that installment multiplied by its fraction and taken to the nearest cent, an exact half cent being rounded up.

## Edges of the bands (hypothetical plan, regular installment 85.00)

| Scheduled installments paid in the span | Ceiling |
|---|---|
| 9 | 85.00 |
| 8 | 42.50 |
| 6 | 42.50 |
| 5 | 21.25 |
| 0 | 21.25 |

A scheduled installment paid exactly 12 whole months before today, or earlier, falls outside the span and does not count toward the record.
